items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28

ctx.x: Who was his favorite son clarinet? Who did he like to use on clarinet?
Well, he usually get this little fella, George Lewis. He had the only lad, George Lewis, he could play with him all the time.
That's what George told me he played since I was.
